 ---------
07/17.02.2023
This application has been filed under Section 407 Cr.P.C. for transfer of Complaint Case No.3280 of 2017 under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
The petitioner is the husband of the opposite party No.2/ complainant namely Soni Khatoon.

It was submitted that at the time of filing of the complaint case, opposite party No.2 was residing at Dhanbad with her brother, but her permanent address is at Itki, Thakurgaon within the Ranchi district and the petitioner is also resident of Ranchi.
It was further submitted that it will be convenient for the both parties if the Complaint Case No.3280 of 2017 is transferred to Ranchi.

Mr. Zaid Ahmed, learned counsel for the opposite party No.2 submitted that the permanent address of the opposite party No.2 is at Ranchi, but now she is residing with her father at Hazaribag and she is not residing presently in Dhanbad.
At the time of institution of this complaint case, the opposite party No.2 was residing at Dhanbad.
It has been admitted that she is presently residing at Hazaribag with her father and her permanent address is at Ranchi.
The petitioner is also resident of Ranchi.

sentences.text: It appears that witnesses of this case are also resident of both Dhanbad and Ranchi.
It will be in the interest of justice and general convenience of the parties and witnesses, if the Complaint Case No.3280 of 2017 is transferred to Ranchi.

Let this Complaint Case No.3280 of 2017 be recalled from the file of learned C.J.M., Dhanbad and transferred to the file of learned C.J.M., Ranchi for needful.
This Transfer Petition is hereby allowed.
(Ambuj Nath, J.) Jay/-
